name: Escape Green
notes: Escape Green 0.1.0-r5. G toggles flight; double-tap Space (450 ms window, timed at keydown) still works, including a second tap that arrives during the 60 ms hold-defer. Holding Space climbs, Shift or C descends, and a Flying HUD chip plus toasts make the state obvious. A touch Fly button matches G. ?debug F9 teleports 50 m along facing and lands on terrain (inert without ?debug). ?debug shows an aggro readout and ?debug&coins=N grants coins (F8 grants +10). Tablet Move stick sits above the hearts; phone hints no longer overlap the sticks or clip the hotbar; touch attack prompts say Tap Attack. Retired biome ids, companion display names, the old camp barn landmark and its sign, a retired book item, an old service-worker comment, and a private art-folder path are stripped. HUD SVG icons are original to this project. Save schema: engine v5 plus Escape Green schema v1. IDB name and Workbox cacheId prefix stay escape-green. SW denylist unchanged. PROXY draw-call caps: High <=150, Low <=70 (Low target <=62). Do not mutate after SHA256SUMS.
